remarks: Welcome to one of the most beautifully updated units in the highly sought-after Candlelight Terrace community. This meticulously maintained first-floor home offers stylish one-level living with luxurious finishes throughout. The kitchen features elegant marble countertops, stainless steel appliances, and high-end materials that make a lasting impression. Enjoy a kitchen that opens to spacious living room and fully renovated bathrooms that blend comfort and modern design. Additional highlights include in-unit washer and dryer, pet-friendly policies, and association dues that cover heat, hot water, and two special assessments. This unit has no rental restrictions! Conveniently located near the Merritt Parkway and I-95 for easy commuting, this home offers both comfort and accessibility. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own one of the nicest units in the complex!
